name: AT&T Access
description: Low-cost home internet for eligible households
fullDescription: AT&T is one of the largest telecommunications companies in the United States. Access from AT&T provides low-cost home internet service to eligible low-income households.
whatTheyOffer:
- Low-cost home internet on AT&T Fiber or AT&T Internet Air
- Monthly price and speed depend on what's available at your address
- Eligible customers with AT&T Fiber or Internet Air may get $10/month off an eligible unlimited AT&T wireless plan
- Existing AT&T internet customers can switch to the lower price once approved
howToGetIt:
1. Enter your address at att.com/internet/access to see options and pricing
2. Qualify through a government program (such as SNAP, SSI, TANF, LIHEAP, federal public housing, or school lunch programs) or household income at or below 200% of the federal poverty guideline
3. Apply online and upload proof of eligibility
4. Once approved, order service or call 855-220-5211 to apply the price to existing service
keywords: AT&T, Access from AT&T, internet, affordable internet, low-income, SNAP, SSI, TANF, LIHEAP, broadband, AT&T Fiber, Internet Air
